card.summary: The America's Living Library Act establishes a pilot program under the Department of the Interior to collect, catalog, and sequence genomic data from animals, plants, fungi, and microbes found in units of the National Park System. The bill provides authorization of appropriations over several fiscal years for program oversight, genome sequencing, sample storage, and data storage across multiple federal entities and the Smithsonian Institution. It also sets data standards, site selection criteria, sample retention and safety rules, tribal consultation requirements, and eventual reporting and termination rules.
